items.title: 3.10 Ionic, covalent, metallic bonds aur intermolecular forces ka muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.10, printed page 69.

blocks.text: Kimiyai bonds, yani ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds, aam taur par asli kimiyai bonds kehlate hain kyunke woh madde ki kimiyai khusoosiyat par asar karte hain: woh electrons ki muntaqili aur shirakat se nayi species banate hain, jabke intermolecular forces molecules ko qareeb lane ka kaam karti aur tabee khusoosiyat par asar karti hain. Magar itna saaf farq hamesha mumkin nahi. Kimiyai bonds aur intermolecular forces ki numayan khasoosiyat un ki bond strength hai, jo bond energy se napi jati hai.

Sodium chloride mein ionic bond ki bond energy (760 kJ fi mol) sab se zyada hai, phir covalent bond (O-H, 464 kJ fi mol) aur ausat hydrogen bond (20 se 25 kJ fi mol). Yeh dikhata hai ke ionic bond kimiyai bonding ki sab se mazboot shakal hai aur kimiyai bonds aam taur par intermolecular forces se kahin mazboot hain. Permanent dipole-dipole forces (5 se 20 kJ fi mol) aur London dispersion forces (1 se 20 kJ fi mol) aur bhi kamzor hain. Metallic bond zyada tar electrostatic quwwaton se samjhaya jata hai, agarche kuch nazariye kehte hain ke yeh covalent nau'iyat ka ho sakta hai; bahar-haal yeh ionic aur covalent dono bonds se kamzor hai, 100 se 150 kJ fi mol ki ausat bond energy ke saath, aur is ki kam mazbooti ki tasalli-bakhsh wajah metallic crystal mein electrons ka wasee delocalization hai.

blocks.prompt: Metallic bond ionic aur covalent bonds se kamzor kyun hai, aur ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds asli kimiyai bonds kyun kehlate hain jabke van der Waals forces nahi?
blocks.explanation: Metal mein valence electrons khas atoms ke darmiyan pakre rehne ke bajaye poore crystal par delocalized hain, to kashish phail kar patli ho jati hai aur ausat bond energy sirf 100 se 150 kJ fi mol hai. Ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds electrons muntaqil ya baant kar nayi species banate hain aur kimiyai khusoosiyat tai karte hain; intermolecular forces sirf maujood molecules ko qareeb lati hain, tabee khusoosiyat par asar karti hain, aur kahin kamzor hain (1 se 50 kJ fi mol).

items: Asli kimiyai bonds (ionic, covalent, metallic) nayi species banate aur kimiyai khusoosiyat tai karte hain; intermolecular forces molecules ko qareeb lati aur tabee khusoosiyat tai karti hain. Bond energy se mazbooti: NaCl ionic 760 > O-H covalent 464 > metallic 100 se 150 > hydrogen bond 20 se 50 > dipole-dipole 5 se 20 > van der Waals 1 se 20 kJ fi mol.
